284442617.description:
Missouri Meerschaum / Hirschl & Bendheim
Corn Cob Pipe Wood Display Plaque
Hardwood, Brass, Corn Cob, Approximately 7.25 x 5 Inches
Vintage tobacciana display plaque celebrating Washington, Missouri's historic legacy as the corn cob pipe capital of the world. The finished dark wood mount features an engraved brass plaque titled "An American Heritage - the original Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Pipe," paired with an authentic corn cob pipe held securely by a metal spring clip. The pipe's bowl retains its original green Hirschl & Bendheim factory label on the underside, representing one of Missouri Meerschaum's most storied historical contemporaries.
Beveled dark-stained wood display plaque with black metal spring retaining clip
Engraved brass nameplate featuring the official Missouri Meerschaum company seal
Corn cob pipe featuring a textured shank, metal ferrule, and amber-colored bit
Original green paper label on pipe base marked Hirschl & Bendheim, Washington, Missouri
Plaque measures approximately 7.25 inches wide by 5 inches tall
Condition:
Wood plaque is structurally sound with light edge wear and minor finish scuffs. Brass plate is securely attached with light surface patina. Pipe shows bowl interior darkening and charring consistent with prior use. Exterior cob bowl and amber stem show light handling wear. Underside factory sticker is intact and legible.

Virginia Mineral & Rock Collection
20 Mounted Geological Specimens with Identification Chart
From the Collection of Rudolph J. Bland, Jr.
Authentic boxed collection of 20 mineral and rock specimens representing various counties across the Commonwealth of Virginia. Assembled from the collection of noted Virginia mineralogist Rudolph J. Bland, Jr., this educational reference set features an indexed label on the interior lid pairing each numbered specimen with its mineral type and county locality. Also includes a group of accompanying loose stones, a projectile point, and a seashell.
Contains 20 Virginia specimens including amazonite, amethyst, staurolite, unakite, prehnite, and petrified wood
Interior lid index clearly lists specimen identity and Virginia county of origin
Mounted in compartmentalized cardboard presentation mailer box
Includes additional loose pieces: projectile point, tumbled stones, and seashell
Measures 11.5 x 8 x 2.75 inches
